title: Segmented control
description: A compact control for choosing one of 2-5 mutually exclusive options that switch a view or mode immediately (list/grid, monthly/annual, day/week/month). Segments have equal visual weight, a clear selected state, and text labels.
intent: Switch between a few views or modes in one click, with the current choice obvious.
characteristics: 2-5 segments with short text labels (icons only with labels)
selected state differs by more than color (fill plus weight or indicator)
width fits content, or equal widths in a constrained toolbar
interaction: Behaves as a single-select radio group: Tab enters at the selected segment, arrow keys move and select. If segments switch panels of content, use the tabs pattern instead.
responsive: Stays one row; when labels do not fit at narrow widths, switch to a select element rather than truncating.
accessibility: Native radio inputs styled as segments, or role="radiogroup" with role="radio" and aria-checked; group has a visible or aria label; selected state meets 3:1 non-text contrast.
limitations: Not for more than five options or for options that need explanation.
Not for actions; use buttons for things that do something rather than select something.
